message.content:
This document describes **Project Maya**, a local LLM inference stack for running large MoE models on consumer/prosumer hardware. Key technical points:

**Core design**
- Runs quantized MoE models with experts streamed from RAM/SSD when they don't fit in VRAM ("any amount of memory").
- OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs with streamed tool calls; supports up to 8 concurrent requests (`--parallel`), which improves aggregate throughput by batching dense-weight reads.
- Browser chat + live hardware monitor; thinking levels (Off/Low/High/Max); vision support.
